texts.f8675c85-4ff9-4519-9a2c-624ec48ac447: The marked portion 'my coworker Priya worked the grill' needs no commas because: || Priya is essential to identify which coworker. || Appositives always take commas. || Coworker is a proper noun. || The sentence is a fragment either way.
texts.f94a7b05-2676-4593-82b0-d557e0a6bdf3: Which option most concisely revises the marked portion 'from paint chips no bigger than postage stamps'? || from paint chips no bigger than postage stamps || from postage-stamp paint chips || from chips of paint that are small like stamps || from tiny paint chips that are quite small
texts.fbf047cc-56cd-4d03-8baa-739c168400de: The phrase 'drinks up mistakes' in Sentence 13 is most appropriate because it: || Proves copper wick is technically superior to all alternatives. || Shows the grandfather drinks alcohol while working. || Fills space before the baseball game passage. || Matches the essay's warm, gently humorous tone toward patient teaching.
texts.0ed173ca-83af-4ac6-b101-2d5a4324a56e: The corkboard and the pharmacist details function in the passage as: || Evidence for the invisible infrastructure of daily collisions. || Examples of businesses that survived the store’s closing. || A list of the researchers’ primary data sources. || Proof that Harlan’s charged unfair prices.
texts.0fe59a5e-3ab8-4a20-bd20-938148b67056: The researchers matched town pairs by income, car ownership, and age primarily to: || Select towns most likely to welcome a farmers’ market. || Satisfy the economist who reviewed the study. || Prove that grocery stores cause higher incomes. || Rule out paychecks and demographics as explanations for the difference.
texts.19b41854-e205-4dfe-9164-a73c4f164681: The curator's central complaint about the gallery is that it: || Contains no authentic artifacts from the Roman period. || Is less popular with visitors than traditional galleries. || Costs more to operate than ticket sales can support. || Teaches visitors to feel certain about debated matters.
texts.2381b06b-d962-4102-9c0e-107efc9a057c: Covering the ants' eyes with opaque caps mattered to the researchers because it: || Measured exactly how far an ant can travel without visual landmarks. || Proved that ants navigate entirely by smell when blinded. || Showed that direction information comes from light, separating direction from distance. || Demonstrated that blinded ants panic and cannot search systematically.
texts.2eaa71e6-7f63-4a0f-bbd8-f3623c09513c: The author's attitude toward the rival group's objection is best described as: || Dismissive, treating the rival interpretation as unworthy of discussion. || Evenhanded, presenting the objection and the reply that answers it. || Hostile, suggesting the rivals falsified their observations. || Uncertain, leaving readers unable to tell which side is correct.
texts.38ca8c23-4f7a-452b-acac-0a08d41cee75: The study's main finding is that, compared with factory towns, grocery towns experienced: || No measurable difference in any civic outcome. || Slightly higher grocery prices but stronger community bonds. || A nearly double rate of decline in civic participation. || Faster income recovery due to new farmers’ markets.
texts.3d7cdbb7-626b-4916-b9f3-2cd8fa971094: Which statement best captures the precise point of disagreement? || Whether museums should charge admission. || Whether visitors enjoy the gallery. || Whether reconstructed sound helps or harms historical understanding. || Whether pigeons lived in ancient Rome.
texts.5eda82c6-b1fe-4678-8e20-d4026b1fb14f: The final paragraph primarily serves to: || Declare the economist the winner of the debate. || Show that both sides accept the decline while disputing its meaning. || Prove that Saturday markets always save dying towns. || Introduce an entirely new study with different towns.
texts.6483c86e-d82f-4232-bbf1-5ba7d215a009: Which evidence, if true, would most strengthen the archaeologist against the curator? || Pigeons prefer museum columns to park statues. || Visitors tested a month later retain the grain-trade facts at high rates. || The gallery's speakers were manufactured in the same city. || The curator once praised a silent exhibition.
texts.6afeb40e-c481-4b40-81c4-fdae9acc3447: The central idea of the passage is that desert ants navigate primarily by: || Combining a sky compass for direction with a stride-based odometer for distance. || Memorizing the positions of pebbles and cracks on the salt flats. || Timing their journeys with an internal clock calibrated at dawn. || Following scent trails laid down by nestmates on previous trips.
texts.758a6a1e-75bd-4393-83e5-2b9003a061f1: The archaeologist's main response to the curator is that: || Silence presents its own false certainty, and documented sound is honest work. || Pigeons should be removed from all museum exhibits. || Curators lack the training to judge acoustic science. || Reconstructions are flawless and need no documentation.
texts.7aa7811f-537d-40ff-b259-24e6724daee2: Passage B's reference to 'a quiet gallery with labels' functions as: || An admission that the curator is entirely correct. || A description of the author's favorite museum. || A concession that labels are always superior to sound. || A counterexample showing silence also presents a false certainty.
texts.8551bdb6-3e74-4733-bf90-33f03b6d4a75: Which finding would most weaken the economist's position? || That matched towns with equal incomes diverged exactly where their stores diverged. || That highway bypasses reduce traffic to small towns. || That Marlow's store eventually closed too. || That voter turnout is difficult to measure precisely.
texts.8b9783eb-5001-46ea-a5c3-aede85368fa0: All of the following are true of Ellis EXCEPT that he: || Agrees with Ray that the orchard should never be sold. || Brings the developer's paperwork to the orchard. || Counts rows aloud while picking beside Ray. || Loads apples for his children before driving home.
texts.a56a4572-c300-4580-8783-7d7be51ca121: In context, the ants' 'vector' most nearly means: || The tightening search loops the ants make after missing the nest. || A straight line drawn by researchers to mark the release point. || A disease the stilts may have transmitted between nests. || The calculated homeward course, with a direction and a length.
texts.a8d5fc8a-29ec-46ac-859a-f82cbf4ab108: On the pigeons, the two authors would most likely agree that: || They should be cut from the mix. || They distract only children. || Visitors remember them vividly. || They prove reconstructions accurate.
texts.b3d40797-15a4-4dc4-9df9-eb94d8cc6a0b: The passage as a whole is organized as: || An argument that laboratory experiments cannot reveal animal behavior. || A chronological history of desert exploration from the first expeditions to the present. || A mystery posed, a two-part solution tested, an objection answered, and a remaining puzzle. || A comparison of two ant species with opposite navigation strategies.
texts.b760b2cc-e886-451d-92f4-d612bfe58528: The market anomaly is awkward for the sociologists because their theory predicts: || Farmers’ markets should outperform all grocery stores. || Economists should refuse to review sociology papers. || Income matching should be impossible in small samples. || Weekly gathering should be too infrequent to preserve participation.
texts.c0020173-48e5-45a8-8e48-ae33ea45e3f0: The curator's perspective is best described as that of: || A builder proud of an attraction's popularity. || A steward worried the medium undermines the mission. || A scholar who believes all reconstruction is fraud. || A tourist delighted by immersive technology.
texts.c131b52c-1692-459c-8e89-e110c0bdf6c1: The passage most strongly supports which claim about the brothers? || Ellis has already decided to sell and is merely humoring Ray for a week. || Ray refuses to look at the folder because he cannot read financial statements. || The brothers’ quarrel over the limb ends any chance of reconciliation. || Each brother fully understands the other's reasons even while disagreeing.
texts.c2806b90-d5b1-4cc1-bbab-abcff9b82a2e: The passage is organized as: || Two rival biographies of the researchers who led the study. || A step-by-step manual for opening a farmers’ market. || A single closed store, a comparative study, a proposed mechanism, an objection, and an unresolved puzzle. || A history of American grocery chains from 1950 to the present.
texts.c42d957a-bc26-4b5d-8ed3-f58792c718e5: The curator's remark about pigeons implies that memorable details can: || Outshine the substantive content they were meant to carry. || Prove a reconstruction is historically accurate. || Replace the need for written labels entirely. || Demonstrate superior Roman engineering.
texts.ca515fe8-d234-416c-b995-334cd1f962e7: The stilt-walkers' systematic looping searches past the nest indicate that: || The researchers had accidentally released the ants too close to home. || Only the length of their homeward vector was wrong, not its direction. || Stilts improve an ant's sense of direction while harming its odometer. || Panicked ants eventually calm down and resume normal navigation.
texts.cc58690d-7dbf-451a-95da-c678af2724a1: Based on Table 1, which conclusion is best supported? || Stride length, not travel time, controls how far the ants go. || Longer travel times produce proportionally longer journeys. || Altered legs destroy the ants’ sense of direction. || Normal ants travel exactly twice as far as stump-walkers.
texts.cf563daf-d2c2-4344-83ea-b48325a1e54a: Ray's story about grafting primarily serves to imply his belief that: || Ellis lacks the skill to maintain the orchard on his own. || Old trees should be replaced with newer, more profitable varieties. || Unlike things can be joined with patience, as he hopes the family can be. || Their father cared more about experiments than about providing for the family.
texts.d549a929-c122-4240-a9a4-d23d774e3492: Table 1 shows stump-walkers stopping short after the same travel time as normal ants. This comparison most directly rules out: || Light-based finding of direction. || Systematic searching after a miss. || Stride-based measurement of distance. || Time-based measurement of distance.
texts.d6c6e56f-2937-4084-acf9-784e5f0f94eb: The archaeologist would most likely respond to the curator's 'authority' objection by pointing to: || The curator's lack of acoustic training. || A different museum with no sound at all. || The ticket revenue the gallery generates. || The documented, sourced, adjustable nature of every track.
texts.ead565d7-5f3c-4f94-97ab-15b7c8d77190: In context, the coupons for 'pantry staples' refer to goods that are: || Fastened together with metal clasps for bulk pricing. || Basic and essential to everyday life. || Legally required to be stocked by grocers. || Imported from overseas at great expense.
texts.f1d62380-a899-4ab6-9734-0d69010c376a: The economist's example of Marlow is meant to show that: || Decline can occur even where the store survives, implicating income and access instead. || Highway bypasses invariably destroy small towns. || Sociologists fabricated their attendance figures. || Grocery stores always prevent civic decline.
texts.f60dbf8b-0765-48d3-9e44-a01f7b18e4c0: Which claim is best supported by the stilt-and-stump experiment? || Polarized light becomes useless to ants once their legs are altered. || Ants count their steps only on the outbound trip, never on the return. || Ants judge distance by stride, because equal travel times produced unequal journeys. || Ants with longer legs are braver and therefore travel farther from the nest.
texts.febfad59-7dd8-4234-b7e9-a3bb2521d3a2: The grafting anecdote functions in the passage primarily as: || A technical digression explaining how Honeycrisp trees are cultivated. || An extended metaphor through which Ray states his position without arguing it. || Evidence that the father neglected the orchard's finances for experiments. || A flashback establishing exactly when the brothers stopped getting along.
